source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic view of a flat, front-on carved plaster wall panel filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no directional shadows, no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Bukhara and Khiva carved ganch (gypsum stucco) architectural wall relief: a crisp two-plane geometric girih lattice of interlocking ten-pointed stars, polygons and fine double-fillet strapwork enclosing delicate carved palmette scrolls and stippled honeycomb backgrounds cut 10 mm deep with sharp gouge and knife tool marks, matte chalky gypsum texture. Keep colours very muted, chalky ivory-white to pale warm grey (#eee9df on raised bands, #c6bfb2 in recessed grounds), near-colourless and even so a palette tint can colour it cleanly.
source.reuse: Urban Tabisti roof-sheltered white ganch veranda panels (kits/tabisti, ganch, 1.15 m); carved Central Asian or Moorish gypsum stucco
